description_zh: 用于抖音文案提取、小红书视频转文字，以及 B站、YouTube 等视频的口播稿和字幕提取。支持批量处理、带时间轴的逐字稿和 SRT/VTT 字幕导出。需要登录 Videosays 并有可用分钟数。
description_en: Turn video links into transcripts, timestamped text, or SRT/VTT subtitles. Supports batch transcription across YouTube, TikTok, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and other supported platforms. Requires a Videosays account and available credits.
author: Wegofuture
